subject: Post-call recap: control matrix & quota requirements for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodai.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T15:06:00-05:00
Subject: Post-call recap: control matrix & quota requirements for Nimbus Health

Anna — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Below is a concise recap so we have alignment and clear next steps. I kept to bullets for your team and ours.

Quick summary of what we heard (pain points)
- Need fine-grained per-customer controls: rate limits, token quotas, and feature-level caps (search vs. chat).
- Routing by plan: premium customers routed to higher-resource pool / lower-latency instances; fallback to cheaper model variants when capacity constrained.
- Predictable unit economics: need an estimate for 95/99q cost per 1M tokens by plan profile.
- PHI/regulatory constraint: some workloads must be kept on-prem or in a VPC-backed private deployment.
- Observability: token-level billing and traceability per customer + audit logs for compliance.

Current stack you shared
- Primary: Open APIs for embeddings & LLM callouts (3rd-party model providers) + in-house vector DB.
- A small on-prem inference cluster for PHI workflows.
- Billing and plan data live in Stripe + internal entitlement service.

Success criteria (what would make this a win)
- Implement per-customer rate limiting and quotas enforceable at the platform edge.
- Ability to route by customer plan with automated fallback rules and measurable latency SLOs (target: P99 < 400ms for conversational queries up to 512 tokens).
- Clear billing/reporting per customer and per-feature within 30 days of go-live.
- Support for private deployment option for PHI dataset (VPC or on-prem bundle).

Questions / clarifications we need from you
- Which features must be on-prem vs. can be hosted? (you mentioned diagnostics & sensitive ingestion)
- Expected peak per-customer qps and token mix (quick estimate for sizing).

Proposed next steps (our side + yours)
1) Technical deep-dive with Nimbus infra + platform engineers (45–60m) — propose week of Nov 29. Monica + Tessa will lead.
2) We’ll send a control-matrix template (attachment) and a back-of-envelope estimate for two profile tiers by Nov 24.
3) You to confirm list of attendees for the deep-dive and share any non-disclosure requirements (NDA/procurement).
4) If alignment, we can scope a short POC: enforce per-customer rate limits + routing for a single premium tenant for 4 weeks.

Attachments: Redwood-Controls-Checklist.pdf (control matrix template), Estimate-Nimbus-Profiles.xlsx (initial ballpark).

Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks Rishi — this looks correct and useful. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 
- PHI note: our ingestion pipeline for patient messages must remain on-prem; however, we can route derived embeddings to a hosted service if it meets SOC2 and VPC peering requirements.
- Quotas: we need both daily and monthly token caps per customer and a way to throttle feature X (batch summarization) separately.
- Throughput: examples — premium tenants hit ~180 qps at peak and sustained 40 qps; conversational queries average ~350 tokens.

Next steps for us: I’ll confirm the platform engineers for the deep-dive (likely Liam + Priya) and loop in procurement if we want NDA before sharing more detailed numbers.

Anna Lopez
